mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a persistent trend signal without threshold activation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from t-1
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100, it signals a manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 5.0% (year-over-year) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in industrial production exceeding 1.0 percentage point above 102.0 signals robust manufacturing activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 102.0 and 3-month change > 1.0pp.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in employment growth and inflation signal an overheating economy, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL both increase from t-1
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both PAYEMS and CPIAUCSL increase from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1700 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1700.
